title: Chocomallows | Astronomical
description: Do regular Marshmallows taste boring to you? Try Chocomallows!
body: ![Chocomallows!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ac11d38542d63daaae2707e5a5e4afcc406fe8c.png)Chocomallows is a simple Resource Pack that changes doctor4t's Astronomical's Marshmallows to look Chocolate flavored! I want to give credit to the mod creators, especialy the Texture artists who made the original Marshmallow texture. [https://modrinth.com/mod/astronomical](https://modrinth.com/mod/astronomical)
